text:
QUOTE: "The 16-bit code is split into a high-level module ID (bits `0xFF80`) and a low-level code (`~0xFF80`). Each has its own generated switch ... and a code can carry both parts." and "else append \" : \" and mbedtls_low_level_strerr(ret)"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that a code has high-level and low-level parts and that strerror outputs both joined by " : " when both are present.
